title: Maximum velocity v1
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (1) as v1 = (2 B1 q L) / m.

title: Time in magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (2) as t = (2π m) / (3 q B1).

title: Minimum velocity v2
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (3) as v2 = (4 B1 q L) / m.

title: Ratio η
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (4) as η = 60% or 0.6.

title: Geometry for v1
description: Important: Applies the geometric condition (e.g., r1 cos60° = r1 - L) to relate the circular path radius in Region I to the width L.

title: Circular motion period
description: Important: Uses the formula for the period of circular motion in a uniform magnetic field, T = 2πm/(qB1), to find the time spent.

title: Geometry for v2
description: Important: For B2=2B1, sets up and solves the geometric constraints involving the circular arcs in both regions to find the required radius.

title: Impulse theorem application
description: Important: For the non-uniform field in part (4), applies the impulse-momentum theorem (Bqv_y Δt = mΔv_x) or integrates to find the velocity condition for crossing the x-axis.

title: Velocity distribution analysis
description: Optional: Correctly interprets the uniform speed distribution and calculates the proportion of ions within the derived critical velocity range.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in geometric relations (e.g., wrong quadrant for angles) or omits/incorrectly uses units in final expressions.

title: Incorrect force balance
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly equates magnetic force to mv^2/r or misapplies the centripetal force condition for non-circular or non-uniform field trajectories.
